text_block_list.text:
With Смарт Фалкон's victory in the Teio
Sho, she's
steadily bringing to life her
promised winning
streak.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But in the back of her mind, it still
bothers her
that the hype has yet to
reach the level of the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, student council president
Symboli
Rudolf, the famed seven-crown
champion, shows
up to acknowledge
Smart Falcon's contributions
to dirt
racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон's next race is the JBC
Classic, and
her determination is all the
stronger after hearing
the president's
expectations for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
